# AI HR Pilot

> AI HR policy and compliance copilot for HR teams at companies with 50 to 2,000 employees. Answers employee questions from the company's own handbook with a citation to the exact section, scores every question for legal risk, routes sensitive topics (ADA, FMLA, harassment, wage disputes) to a human, and keeps an audit log. Built by Yuri Kruman, a three-time CHRO with a JD. Published by Portfolio Leverage Company (PortLev). Last updated 2026-09-02.

Every statement in this file is verifiable in the product or its source. Claims we cannot verify (SOC 2 audit, Slack/Teams channels) are stated as not yet available.

## What it does
- Answers employee questions from uploaded handbook and policy documents (PDF, Word), citing the section used.
- Scores each question for legal risk using keyword, topic-category and context signals; critical topics are never answered by AI and become cases for HR or legal.
- Carries federal employment-law context plus 11 state jurisdictions: California, New York, Texas, Illinois, Colorado, Washington, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Florida, Georgia, Pennsylvania (final pay, PTO payout, meal breaks, sick leave, pay transparency, non-compete, minimum wage, overtime threshold, at-will status).
- 18 pre-mapped policy topics across leave, benefits, compensation, workplace policies, career, employment status, workplace issues and compliance.
- Regulatory update feed of federal and state changes with source links (DOL, EEOC, state labor departments).
- Team roles (HR admin, HR staff, legal, employee), case management, self-service requests (PTO, leave, info changes), analytics, audit log.
- Read-only, one-way payroll/HRIS sync: Gusto, BambooHR, QuickBooks Payroll, Finch (covers ADP Workforce Now, Paychex, Paylocity, UKG Pro and 25+ others). AI HR Pilot never writes to payroll.
- Web app today. Slack and Microsoft Teams channels are on the roadmap, not live.

## Who it is for
HR Directors, VPs of People and CHROs at 50 to 2,000 person companies; HR operators inside private-equity portfolio companies running multi-state teams; Series A-C tech, healthcare, professional services and manufacturing companies using Gusto, BambooHR, QuickBooks Payroll or Rippling.

## Pricing (USD, monthly, as of 2026-09-02)
- Starter: $99/month. Up to 100 employees, 10 handbook documents, cited answers, risk triage and escalation, federal + 11-state context, ticket tracking, basic analytics, email support.
- Professional: $349/month. Up to 500 employees, 50 documents, everything in Starter plus team roles, case management, self-service requests, full analytics and audit log, payroll/HRIS sync, priority email support.
- Enterprise: $999/month. Unlimited employees and documents, everything in Professional plus custom escalation rules, quarterly policy review session with a 3x CHRO, dedicated onboarding, response-time commitment.
- All plans: 7-day free trial, no credit card required, month to month, cancel any time.

## Security (stated plainly)
- Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest via infrastructure providers (Vercel, Neon). Authentication by Clerk (SOC 2 Type II certified provider). Payments by Stripe (PCI DSS Level 1).
- Every database query is scoped to the organization server-side; roles enforced on every API route; audit logging of questions, answers, escalations and admin actions.
- Customer documents and conversations are not used to train AI models.
- No SSNs or bank routing numbers stored from payroll sync.
- AI HR Pilot has NOT completed its own SOC 2 audit or a third-party penetration test yet. SSO/SAML is not yet available (Google and Microsoft OAuth are).

## Compared to alternatives
- Moveworks: $200K to $1M+/year, built for 10,000+ employee enterprises, 3-9 month implementations. AI HR Pilot serves 50 to 2,000 at $99 to $999/month.
- Leena AI: $50K to $200K+/year, enterprise HR service delivery. AI HR Pilot is self-serve.
- Workativ: from $349/month, general-purpose chatbot adapted for HR/IT. AI HR Pilot is HR-specific with risk triage and jurisdiction context.
- Details: https://aihrpilot.com/compare
